Lina: tagging in case folks saw the evening invoice for March 22 — there's a ~$3.6k duplicate charge on GPU line items across us-west1/us-central1. It looks like the same metering_id was charged twice.

cost-bot: ALERT: invoice_discrepancy detected. invoice_id=INV-2026-03-22-332, suspect_dup=3600.00, regions=[us-west1,us-central1]

Omar: yikes. can you paste the invoice lines or a snippet? vendor portal is a mess.

Lina: pasted snippet below (redacted):
```
SKU: GPU-T4-ONDEMAND | metering_id: mtr-9f7a | region: us-west1 | amount: 1800.00
SKU: GPU-T4-ONDEMAND | metering_id: mtr-9f7a | region: us-central1 | amount: 1800.00
```
Both tie to the same `mtr-9f7a`. Our billing ingestion normally maps metering_id -> resource_id -> team. If metering_id is reused across regions for pooled spot instances then we double-count.

Priya: hmm. We saw a vendor change last month where they collapsed meter scopes. Could be a backend change. Omar, any infra changes to the metering export?

Omar: No infra-side change. Vendor rolled out a billing export update (we got a notice) that now splits preemptible allocations by host-region but keeps a global metering_id. Our ingestion assumes metering_id unique per region.

Nate: so ingestion rule bug. Quick mitigation: dedupe by (metering_id, invoice_line_date, sku) and prefer region with higher usage match to our usage_events. But we need to ensure we don't undercharge valid multi-region usages.

Lina: for retro and immediate fix we need: 1) a reconciled mapping for the invoice period 2) suggested journal entries per team 3) alert rule to catch similar duplicates earlier.

Priya: propose plan: run a join of vendor_invoice_lines to our usage_events on (metering_id, date_range) and aggregate by resource_id. If the same metering_id maps to different regions but the resource_id shows activity only in one region, attribute to that resource. Where multiple resource_ids exist, split by observed GPU_hours.

Lina: can you drop the SQL you plan to run? finance wants the output CSV.

Priya: sure, rough query: 
```
SELECT v.metering_id, v.region as vendor_region, ue.region as our_region, ue.resource_id, sum(ue.gpu_hours) as gpu_hours, v.amount
FROM vendor_invoice_lines v
LEFT JOIN usage_events ue ON v.metering_id = ue.metering_id AND ue.ts BETWEEN v.start_date AND v.end_date
WHERE v.invoice_id = 'INV-2026-03-22-332'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,6
ORDER BY v.metering_id, gpu_hours desc;
```
Will output a CSV with per-resource allocation suggestions.

Omar: I'll add a dedupe rule in ingestion pipeline as a hotfix: prefer (metering_id, sku, invoice_date) dedupe with `region_bias` heuristics off by default; we'll enable region_bias=true for now. But keep feature-flagged.

cost-bot: NOTE: created ticket FIN-3412 for vendor-meter-duplication. link: tickets.internal/FIN-3412

Nate: for retro journals, finance prefers line-level memos. Lina, can you confirm threshold for automated retros? Last time it was >$500.

Lina: yes, continue >$500. This duplicate is >$500 per team in a couple cases so we'll need journals. I'll prep the template.

Priya: I'll run the query now and push CSV to /shared/finance/invoice-recon/INV-2026-03-22-332.csv and tag the top 20 suspect resource_ids. Expect ~30m.

Omar: after CSV, I'll stage the ingestion patch behind FF and run a dry-run on the last 60 days to estimate impact. We should measure both delta and false-positive risk.

Lina: thanks. please ping finance once CSV ready. Also cc vendor-billing@ so we can get a formal correction request from them if the invoice is wrong.
